no-whole-pixel-floor.undoes: A — the fit uses whole pixels, so a fractional canvas cannot round into overflow
no-whole-pixel-floor.why: the floor changes the fit's input when the canvas is fractional, but no visible outcome was measured to change; see unguarded

no-whole-pixel-floor.unguarded: Reached, but with no visible effect: fractional canvases occur (in 664 of 720 of review R2's sweep steps, MEASURED by R2; in about a third of the frames of a panel slide, 19 to 20 of 60 to 61 in 3 runs, MEASURED by the step 11 claims audit's scratch probe audit/claims/fractional-canvas-probe.mjs). Yet without the floor, a visible defect (overflow, a scrollbar, a hidden sheet) appeared in 0 of 720 steps (MEASURED by R2). No check can show it; it is kept as a cheap guarantee against a sub-pixel edge (INSPECTED).
